title: The header card carries a clearable Sales Representative field
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit.
  2. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: top menu Customers -> New Customer, enter a Name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save.
  3. A part sale that is not invoiced or paid. Seed it: top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, pick the Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save; in the Add Part dialog that opens enter a Description (e.g. "Brake Pads"), Quantity 1 and a Sell Price (e.g. $290.91), then click Save & Close.
  4. The shop has at least one active sales representative: click your initials at the top right -> Settings -> Staff -> on a staff member's row click the edit icon -> in Edit Staff Member turn on Sales Representative -> Save & Close.
custom_steps:
1. Open the part sale and read its header card (below the sale number and Started date).
  2. Find the Sales Representative field (it reads Unassigned when empty) and click it to open its picker.
  3. Select a rep, then clear the field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The header card carries a Sales Representative field.
  • The picker offers the shop's active sales representatives (Unassigned first), and the field can be cleared. (On a shop with no reps flagged the picker reads "No results".)
